title: Talking with Jehovah's Witnesses
tagline: Their claims on the Trinity, Christ, the divine name, blood and 1914, heard in their own words and answered kindly.
whyItMatters: Witnesses knock on doors because they care about the Bible. A calm Catholic who knows the Church's teaching on Christ can have a real conversation.

mindset.tip: See a sincere person who studies the Bible. Be courteous and ready to listen. (1 Peter 3:15-16; CCC 856)
Know what they hold from their own pages before you reply.
Stay on one topic, usually who Jesus is, and ask questions more than you assert.
Be gentle: many Witnesses risk losing family and friends if they ask questions. Offer friendship, not pressure. (CCC 2477)
Keep to the Bible they use and to the Church's early witness about Christ. (CCC 464-465)
